chapter: Buck and Bubbles: Nazarro and Bubbles
title: The first performance with Buck and Bubbles was a sensation
summary: Audiences did not know whether the boys were Buck and Bubbles' sons; repeating their jokes drew an immediate response in variety theatres.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Let's get back now to your first performance with Buck and Bubbles, and what was that like?
Well, it was an immediate sensation. Because it was a great surprise to the public. These little

ones coming out there. They didn't know whether Buck and Bubbles had had some sons or what, you know. And by us repeating some of the jokes that Buck and Bubbles had been telling out there already that made the audience laugh, and we come out there and repeat the same jokes, and situation comedy, you know. It was an immediate sensation. That's what brought us all back together, like Nazarra, he would be back stage or out in the audience. He was watching how it worked out, because it was the two of them's idea, you see. They got so they was saying which one said the idea should be done in the act. So J.D. and I went out to do whatever they thought we should do. So we'd have to go out there and try it out with the audience, see? Different shows, see. Because we was in variety theater then, and that was variety shows. It wasn't so much vaudeville. See, the vaudeville acts was getting less and less vaudeville acts. Variety shows was becoming more popular, you see?
